prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
**BBS Insurance** looks like a strong first call for a self-employed person living in Kansas City, Missouri. It’s an independent local agency that says it compares ACA Marketplace plans across carriers, checks doctors, and helps estimate subsidies. Its site lists a **5.0 Google rating from 90 reviews** and a client example involving a 1099 contractor. Call **(816) 205-4664** or visit [BBS Insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/service-areas/kansas-city/). Broker help is described as free; confirm any fees or compensation when you speak with them.

A good alternative is **Abbott Insurance**, which also describes itself as an independent agent comparing carriers and offers Marketplace coverage: **(816) 452-8810**, [Abbott Insurance](https://abbottkc.com/health-insurance/).

When you contact either, ask them to compare **ACA Marketplace plans** based on your estimated annual income, prescriptions, preferred doctors and hospitals, and expected care. For self-employed people, income can affect eligibility for premium tax credits, so ask how they handle income estimates and updates. You can also verify options directly at [HealthCare.gov](https://www.healthcare.gov/).
